sourceChecks.title: Shannon-entropy-based nonequilibrium “entropic” temperature of a general distribution
sourceChecks.excerpt: we obtain the nonequilibrium entropic temperature for a system satisfying the Langevin equations.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Authors define a Shannon temperature using Hamiltonian curvature and Fisher information and apply it to a Langevin system.
sourceChecks.limitations: A proposed classical statistical definition, not experimental verification across turbulent, active, living and arbitrary quantum systems.

sourceChecks.title: Quasiprobability Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relation
sourceChecks.excerpt: focusing on observables' change rather than exchange of charges through jumps and respecting initial coherence.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Authors formulate a quasiprobability quantum TUR respecting coherence and discuss nonclassical violations of classical bounds.
sourceChecks.limitations: Author-stated formal result under its framework; no independent proof verification or tight model-independent bound for every process.

sourceChecks.title: Strong Coupling Quantum Thermodynamics far away from Equilibrium: Non-Markovian Transient Quantum Heat and Work
sourceChecks.excerpt: the strong coupling quantum thermodynamics of the hybrid quantum system far away from equilibrium.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Authors develop heat and work definitions for a driven cavity and NV-spin hybrid system, including non-Markovian strong-coupling dynamics.
sourceChecks.limitations: Specific modeled hybrid system, not complete fluctuation relations for any bath, coupling and drive.

sourceChecks.title: Thermodynamics of emergent structure in active matter
sourceChecks.excerpt: We quantify steady state entropy production at each point in the phase diagram
sourceChecks.paraphrase: An underdamped model studies entropy production in active phase separation and polar alignment; time reversal choices matter.
sourceChecks.limitations: Model-dependent dynamics, not all collective motion and patterns derived solely from thermodynamic potentials.

sourceChecks.title: Is the Hypothesis About a Low Entropy Initial State of the Universe Necessary for Explaining the Arrow of Time?
sourceChecks.excerpt: In certain recent models of cosmology, however, no hypothesis about the initial state of the universe is invoked.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Discusses particular cosmological models producing arrows without a special initial-state hypothesis, alongside two-sided entropy increase.
sourceChecks.limitations: Relies on cosmological models, explicitly excluded by the assigned assertion; not reversibility alone.

sourceChecks.title: Universal trade-off relation between power and efficiency for heat engines
sourceChecks.excerpt: For a general thermodynamic system described as a Markov process
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Authors derive a Markov-process dissipation/current bound and power-efficiency tradeoff forbidding Carnot efficiency at nonzero power in that framework.
sourceChecks.limitations: Conditional theoretical bound, not exact attainable optimum at every given power for all cycles and substances; proof not independently verified.

sourceChecks.title: Thermodynamics of Non-Elementary Chemical Reaction Networks
sourceChecks.excerpt: It only requires the knowledge of the kinetics and of the standard chemical potentials
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Framework describes thermodynamics of non-mass-action reaction networks given kinetics and standard chemical potentials, with conditions on coarse graining.
sourceChecks.limitations: Requires kinetic information and specified network conditions; not topology-only universal prediction of emergent computation or bistability.

sourceChecks.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation
sourceChecks.excerpt: We discuss these replica wormholes explicitly in two-dimensional Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity coupled to matter.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Authors calculate replica-wormhole entropy saddles in gravitational models including two-dimensional JT gravity coupled to matter.
sourceChecks.limitations: Model-based author result; no universal lab-scale nonequilibrium/gravity unification or independent proof audit.

sourceChecks.title: Negative Absolute Temperature for Motional Degrees of Freedom
sourceChecks.excerpt: Here, we were able to prepare a negative temperature state for motional degrees of freedom.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Experiment creates negative-temperature ultracold bosons through a tailored Bose-Hubbard Hamiltonian and upper band-edge occupation.
sourceChecks.limitations: Optical-lattice ensemble, not a demonstrated unbounded-energy-spectrum system. No universal heat-engine or third-law result.
